column3: The Rhapsody of the Departure Eve
W-Well! It'll work itself out!
Kyou-chan, are you really all right?
I'm getting more and more worried about Kyou-chan after this...
Don't worry about it! Okay?
If Kyou-chan says so...
But don't do anything reckless, got it?
You're worrying too much.
Even if you say so...
It's all right...! Have I ever lied to you?
Y-You're right...
However, don't do anything reckless! Feel free to rely on me if anything happens!
Yeah, thank you, Manami.
This is real bad! I haven't prepared anything!
I finally feel the urgency of this situation!
Besides, what do I need to bring? Or wait, for how many days?
...What are you doing?
Can't you see?! Preparing for tomorrow!
So... You made up your mind...
Made up my mind?
Aren't you leaving home?
Are you stupid?! Of course not!
Eh? That's not it?
What's with that, "That's so unexpected" expression?!
Weren't you going on a trip to find yourself?
When did I lose myself in the first place?
Sorry to disappoint you, but it's just a school trip.
Ohh.
Yeah, fufufu... From tomorrow onwards, I'll be away from you in Kyoto. Haaa, I feel full of energy.
Raw yatsuhashi.
Huh?
Bring back some souvenirs for your super cute little sister.
She must have decided I should bring back her souvenirs the moment she heard the word "Kyoto".
All right. Raw yatsuhashi, then.
What a cheeky sister you might think. But we wouldn't have had such a normal sibling conversation a year ago.
...If you think about it, I'd probably bring her back at least one souvenir anyway.
Say, what are you doing?
Kirino whipped out her mobile phone, typing something.
All right, message sent.
She said while pressing the send button on her phone and flashed a grin in my direction.
What's with that grin... I got a chill going up my spine...
Hehehe... You actually forgot a big event like the school trip. You have surpassed that Fashion monger that I can't help but take pity on you.
Shall I use the power of 【Abe no Seimei】 to remove the curse within your blood?
PS ---- Do present me with pentagram goods when you return.
FROM Kuroneko.
Be sure to visit the anime company 【Heian Animation】 that is located in Kyoto!
HeiAni will shoulder the existence of the anime industry in the future!
Please go in and scout it out in my stead!
By the way! I hear they also sell original goods.
FROM Saori.
How are you faring in this hot and humid weather?
Speaking of which, there's apparently a renowned shop selling amazing 【Oil Absorbing Sheets】.
I'd like to try using those before work.
FROM Ayase.
They're all requests for souvenirs...
It's impossible to buy all of them!
...Huh?
And I received one last message.
Anyway, first will be the raw yatsuhashi. I'll send you another message if I think of more. If you forget, you're dead.
FROM Kirino.
Y-Yo? This sentence "I'll send you another if I think of more"...?
You do understand from reading, right?
I understand! It means you want more!
Exactly.
What a shameless girl...
I get it... I'll buy them for you, so don't bother my preparations.
Anyway, why are you preparing the night just before the school trip? Are you stupid?
W-What a cruel remark...
Besides, what was with her! Staying in my room the eve of the school-trip when I'm freaking busy!
Heh, what are you looking at?
I'm watching because you're obstructing me!
Aha! Could it be that you feel lonely because you're going to be separated from me?
Huh? What is this idiot saying?
I'm saying, you're going to die of loneliness when I'm not around～
Ah, creepy creepy. You're a creepy siscon～
This girl... Can't she hurry up and go somewhere else...?
